topics.title: Plants
topics.description: Discover the world of plants around us!

lessons.title: Types of Plants
lessons.hook: Did you know plants come in many different sizes? Some are tiny, some are HUGE! 🌳
lessons.explanation: Plants can be very big or very small. We divide them into different groups based on their size and the type of stem they have. Let's explore!
lessons.content:
There are 5 main types of plants:

1. **Trees** - Very big and tall with hard, brown stems called trunks. They live for many years!
2. **Shrubs** - Medium-sized plants with strong woody stems
3. **Herbs** - Small plants with soft green stems
4. **Climbers** - Weak plants that need support to grow up
5. **Creepers** - Weak plants that grow along the ground

examples.title: Trees 🌳
examples.description: Big, tall plants like neem, banyan, mango, and coconut trees
examples.visual: Tree with brown trunk and green leaves

examples.title: Shrubs 🌸
examples.description: Medium-sized like rose, sunflower, cotton, and hibiscus

examples.title: Herbs 🌱
examples.description: Small plants like spinach, mint, and coriander - some we eat!

examples.title: Climbers 🏃
examples.description: Weak plants that climb like money plant and grapevine

examples.title: Creepers 🎃
examples.description: Spread on ground like pumpkin and watermelon

lessons.title: Parts of a Plant
lessons.hook: Every plant is like a small factory with special parts that do different jobs! 🏭
lessons.explanation: Plants have many parts, and each part has an important job to help the plant grow and survive.
lessons.content:
The main parts of a plant are:

1. **Root** 📍 - Holds plant in soil, absorbs water and minerals
2. **Stem** 🌿 - Carries water and food to all parts, supports the plant
3. **Leaf** 🍃 - Makes food for the plant using air, water, and sunlight
4. **Flower** 💐 - Produces fruits and seeds
5. **Fruit** 🍎 - Contains seeds that grow into new plants

examples.title: Root - Underground Workers 📍
examples.description: Roots drink water from soil and keep plant standing tall
examples.food_example: Carrot, radish, turnip - we eat roots!

examples.title: Stem - The Delivery System 🌿
examples.description: Stems carry water from roots to leaves and food from leaves to roots

examples.title: Leaf - The Kitchen 🍃
examples.description: Leaves make food for plants using sunlight. It's like a plant's kitchen!

examples.title: Flower - The Fruit Maker 💐
examples.description: Flowers are beautiful and they make fruits and seeds

examples.title: Fruit - Seed Container 🍎
examples.description: Fruits protect seeds inside. When seeds fall, new plants grow!
examples.food_example: Apple, mango, cherry - we eat fruits!

lessons.title: Things We Get From Plants
lessons.hook: Plants give us SO many things we use every day! Let's discover them! 🎁
lessons.explanation: Plants are super useful! They give us food, clothes, medicine, and many other things we need.
lessons.content:
We get many important things from plants:

**Food**: Rice, wheat, vegetables, fruits, spices
**Clothes**: Cotton, jute, linen
**Medicine**: Tulsi, neem, clove
**Other things**: Wood, oil, rubber, paper, perfume, soap

Plants also give us oxygen to breathe!

questions.question: Which of these is a TREE?
questions.hint: Think of the biggest plants. Which one grows very tall and lives for many years?
questions.explanation: Neem is a tree! It's big, tall, and has a hard trunk. Mint is a herb, rose is a shrub, and pumpkin is a creeper.

questions.question: What does a ROOT do?
questions.hint: Roots are underground. What do they drink?
questions.explanation: Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil! They also hold the plant firmly in the ground.

questions.question: We eat the STEM of which plant?
questions.hint: Think about what you eat as a vegetable that grows underground but isn't a root.
questions.explanation: Potato is a stem! It grows underground and we eat it. A carrot is a root, spinach is a leaf, and apple is a fruit.

questions.question: Which plant needs a STICK to grow up?
questions.hint: Some plants have weak stems and need help to climb up.
questions.explanation: Money plant is a climber! It has a weak stem and uses a stick or wall to climb up. Pumpkin is a creeper that spreads on the ground.

questions.question: We wear clothes made from COTTON. Cotton comes from...
questions.hint: Cotton is a soft, fluffy fiber. It surrounds the seeds. What part of the plant has this?
questions.explanation: Cotton comes from the flower! The fluffy cotton fibers surround the seeds inside the flower. These are spun into thread to make clothes.

topics.title: Animals
topics.description: Learn about creatures big and small!

lessons.title: Types of Animals
lessons.hook: The world is full of amazing animals! Some walk, some fly, some swim! 🌍
lessons.explanation: Animals are living things that can move around. We can group them by what they eat or where they live.
lessons.content:
Main groups of animals:

1. **Wild Animals** - Live in forests, jungles, and deserts (lion, tiger, bear)
2. **Domestic Animals** - Live with humans (dog, cat, cow)
3. **Birds** - Have wings and can fly (parrot, crow, eagle)
4. **Water Animals** - Live in water (fish, dolphin, crocodile)
5. **Insects** - Tiny creatures with 6 legs (butterfly, bee, ant)

examples.title: Wild Animals 🦁
examples.description: Tiger, lion, elephant - live in nature

examples.title: Domestic Animals 🐕
examples.description: Dog, cat, cow - live with people

examples.title: Birds 🦅
examples.description: Parrot, crow, peacock - have feathers and wings

examples.title: Water Animals 🐠
examples.description: Fish, turtle, crocodile - live in water

lessons.title: Where Animals Live
lessons.hook: Different animals live in different places! Where would YOU find a fish? 🏜️
lessons.explanation: Animals live in homes called habitats. Each habitat has what the animal needs to survive.
lessons.content:
Different habitats:

1. **Forest** - Trees, shade, wet ground (monkeys, deer, birds)
2. **Desert** - Hot, dry, sandy (camel, snake, scorpion)
3. **Ocean** - Salt water (whale, shark, octopus)
4. **Pond/Lake** - Fresh water (frog, duck, fish)
5. **Mountain** - High, cold (eagle, snow leopard, yak)

examples.title: Forest Habitat 🌳
examples.description: Wet, shady with lots of trees

examples.title: Desert Habitat 🏜️
examples.description: Hot, dry with sand

examples.title: Ocean Habitat 🌊
examples.description: Deep salt water

questions.question: Which animal is a WILD animal?
questions.hint: Wild animals live in forests, not with people.
questions.explanation: Tiger is a wild animal! It lives in forests and jungles. Dog, cat, and cow live with people - they are domestic animals.

questions.question: Where do FISH live?
questions.hint: Think about where you see fish!
questions.explanation: Fish live in water! They need water to breathe and survive.

questions.question: Which animal would you find in a DESERT?
questions.hint: Deserts are hot and dry. Which animal can live without much water?
questions.explanation: Camels live in deserts! They can go without water for a long time and their feet are perfect for walking on sand.

questions.question: What do we call the place where an animal lives?
questions.hint: It's a special word for where wild animals live.
questions.explanation: Habitat is the home of a wild animal! It has everything the animal needs like food, water, and shelter.

questions.question: Which animal can live in BOTH water and on land?
questions.hint: It starts as a tadpole in water, then grows legs!
questions.explanation: Frogs live in both water and on land! Baby frogs (tadpoles) live in water with a tail. Adult frogs jump on land but need to stay near water.

topics.title: Food & Nutrition
topics.description: Discover the food we eat and why we need it!

lessons.title: Types of Food
lessons.hook: What's your favorite food? Every food helps your body in a special way! 🍽️
lessons.explanation: We eat different types of food. Each type helps our body in different ways.
lessons.content:
Main food groups:

1. **Fruits & Vegetables** 🥬 - Give us vitamins and energy (apple, carrot, spinach)
2. **Grains & Cereals** 🌾 - Give us energy (rice, wheat, bread)
3. **Protein Foods** 🥚 - Help our body grow (egg, milk, beans)
4. **Healthy Fats** 🥑 - Keep our body warm (nuts, oil)
5. **Sugars & Sweets** 🍪 - Give quick energy (but eat less of these!)

examples.title: Fruits & Vegetables 🥕
examples.description: Colorful and full of vitamins

examples.title: Grains 🌾
examples.description: Give us energy for running and playing

examples.title: Proteins 🥚
examples.description: Help our body grow strong

lessons.title: Why We Need Food
lessons.hook: Your body is like a machine! Food is the fuel that keeps it running! ⚡
lessons.explanation: Food gives our body energy and helps it grow, stay healthy, and fight sickness.
lessons.content:
Food helps us:

1. **Grow** - Our bones, muscles, and body need food to get bigger
2. **Get Energy** - We need energy to run, play, study, and think
3. **Stay Healthy** - Food keeps our skin, teeth, and eyes strong
4. **Fight Sickness** - Healthy food helps our body fight germs
5. **Repair** - When we get hurt, food helps our body heal

examples.title: For Growing 📏
examples.description: Milk, eggs, beans help us get taller

examples.title: For Energy ⚡
examples.description: Rice, bread, fruit give us power

examples.title: To Stay Healthy 💪
examples.description: Vegetables and fruits keep us strong

questions.question: Which food is a FRUIT?
questions.hint: Fruits grow on trees and are usually sweet!
questions.explanation: Apple is a fruit! It grows on trees and is full of vitamins. Rice, bread, and milk are other food types.

questions.question: Why do we need to eat food?
questions.explanation: We eat food to get energy for running, playing, studying, and growing! Food keeps our body healthy and strong.

questions.question: Which food helps your body GROW strong?
questions.hint: What helps your bones and muscles grow?
questions.explanation: Milk and eggs have protein! Protein helps your body grow and become strong. Candy and sweets taste good but don't help you grow.

questions.question: Which is a HEALTHY lunch?
questions.hint: A healthy meal has different types of food.
questions.explanation: Rice, vegetables, and egg make a healthy meal! You get grains, vitamins, and protein all together.

questions.question: Your body is like a machine. What is food?
questions.hint: What makes a machine run? What makes your body run?
questions.explanation: Food is the fuel for your body! Just like a car needs fuel to run, your body needs food to have energy and grow.
